scope: Read-only audit of existing reports; no RTL, generator, configuration or synthesis changes. Split Add/ReLU and general five-unit ASIC are distinct installed baselines.

units.area: Raw SAED14 library area units from report_area; do not use wire-load Total area as silicon area. report_units explicitly declares time/capacitance but not area.
units.fixed_flow: 2 ns, SAED14 RVT TT 0.8V 25C; medium then incremental Ultra; ideal clock and wire-load, not physical signoff.
units.historical_cgra_flow: 10 ns, same library hashes, low-effort compile; cached native subtree held dont_touch in enclosing endpoint. Timing not closed; macro substitution only statically validated.

fixed_pair_totals.scope: Complete two endpoint closures. Excludes upstream shared AutoLink fabric, Rocket/RoCC selection, shared Gemminis and physical place/route.

cgra.architecture: Attention 4x4, 48 control entries per PE, 128 KiB payload SPM, eight banks

native_subtree.reason_for_512_macros: Width padding: each 35-bit word occupies two 32-bit SRAM slices. Not read-port replication. Metadata/storage semantics must be retained in any alternative mapping.
native_subtree.mapping_limitation: 35-to-64-bit padding is overhead of the chosen SRAM mapping and available macro width, not a universal CGRA architectural requirement. A different memory compiler or separate metadata implementation may reduce padding, but requires a new functionally validated and timing-qualified mapping.
native_subtree.wrapper_validation: The original behavioral native RTL hash matches current RTL. Its historical SRAM-substituted wrapper has static-generation validation only; it is not the cycle-validated current fixed-ASIC wrapper and has not passed common 2 ns timing.

current_config_storage.measurement: No current complete endpoint mapping. Historical trimmed packet-only SRAM inventory cannot replace current packet and patch storage.

notes: All five units are physically instantiated once, irrespective of runtime unit selection. Count shared units once across workloads; do not sum independent per-workload installations.
Unit-local arrays are additional to common SPM. Descriptor/config, DMA, shell, interconnect and shared controller also count.
Available standalone mappings use 10 ns standard-cell arrays and exclude common SPM and shell; they cannot be summed with the 2 ns fixed-endpoint SRAM result.
Gcn has no completed area report; GptVector synthesis was intentionally deferred without a mapped result. Norm/Softmax/Vector available snapshots match current arithmetic source files.

The current split Add/ReLU baseline does not cover GCN/GPT. The earlier general ASIC supports staged/fused operation and resource reuse of its installed units; those results are not measurements of a collection of isolated per-operator ASICs.

fair_comparison_requirements: Measure both complete installed backends at the same clock, PVT, implementation effort, numeric semantics and workload coverage; retain setup/hold and DRC outcomes.

Include all local data, metadata, unit-local arrays, configuration and patch storage, adapter/DMA and endpoint-dependent shared control. Report physical macro granularity separately from logical payload capacity.
Use only one frozen CGRA across workloads and one frozen ASIC inventory covering their union; distinguish per-workload subset area from installed union area.
Count common CPU/Gemmini/fabric consistently, or subtract only proven common identical hardware. The co-installed validation SoC is not either deployment alone.

Account for current unequal cache capacity: CGRA 32 jobs ×192 packets plus patches versus split ASIC 4 descriptors per endpoint. Choose capacity from required workload schedules, not from desired result.
conclusion: Existing measurements do not establish CGRA cost savings. The known split-ASIC endpoints are small outside their SRAM, while historical CGRA area is larger and physically padded; those numbers have incompatible timing/endpoint/configuration scope and are not a normalized ratio. Cross-workload installed ASIC total and current complete CGRA cost remain unmeasured. Resource reuse is functionally demonstrated by one frozen CGRA executing several kernels, but net silicon-area benefit requires the missing matched inventory and implementation measurements.
bounded_followup: No credible <=10-minute complete 2 ns CGRA synthesis closure: historical native subtree synthesis took about 10971 seconds and failed timing. A cached-subtree shell estimate could update only the shell and would still not establish equal-frequency total cost.
